summary: Not published; the candidate was dropped before any flip, and for two independent reasons. Task quality: the recorded drop rationale is that the label (month-over-month decline of the within-4-hour rate) is dominated by persistence and seasonality, and the record requires a publication-date archive before any re-open. Leakage risk: the construction has the same structural shape as the demonstrated cross-row class - the label's operands are a provider's M+1 monthly rates, which a later row for the same provider ships as feature months - so any re-open must assume the same reverse-history join applies until a blind-join battery proves otherwise. Publication timing is the one well-evidenced property: month-M CSVs were observed publishing 9-13 days after period end and the task takes the maximum.
